product_one_liner.value: Authenticate provides businesses with an identity-verification and background-check platform that confirms users’ identities and checks associated criminal, driving, employment, and education records.
product_one_liner.notes: The official homepage defines the product as an identity-verification platform and specifies the criminal, driving, employment, and education records it checks; its surrounding product description is aimed at users and businesses.

pricing_page.notes: The official homepage navigation includes Pricing and the same page displays a public pricing schedule with per-check amounts, so the company has a public pricing page.

founded_year.notes: The company LinkedIn page states it was founded in 2018, and the matching authenticatedotcom profile repeats that year. Some third-party company profiles have a conflicting 2017 date, so 2018 is the best-supported value but the discrepancy warrants medium confidence.

eng_blog.notes: The official blog index describes itself as identity-verification resources and its visible article sections are industry guides, product explainers, and customer-facing material rather than engineering build reports. Reviewing the index did not reveal the two engineer-authored technical posts required for a true value; this is a classification from the index rather than an explicit company statement.
